semantic_scope: Animal ears that are not real; commonly present on accessories such as hairbands, hoods, or hats. Distinguish from actual animal features.
source_excerpt: Animal ears that are not real. Commonly found on hairbands and hoods but can also show up on hats. Not to be confused with kemonomimi mode, in which a character is depicted with actual animal features which they do not normally have.

semantic_scope: A collar decorated with one or more bells; the collar relation is intrinsic and must not be dropped to generic bell.
source_excerpt: A collar decorated with one or more bells. They are usually used on small domestic pets (such as cats) as a way of listening to their location if they wander too far from their home.

semantic_scope: Image composition where one side of a character's face is shown; not character statistics/profile data.
source_excerpt: When one side of the character's face is shown. When talking about a character's profile (i. e. height, weight, blood type, breast size, etc.), use stats and/or character profile instead.

semantic_scope: A visible gap between the upper thighs directly under the crotch when the knees or thighs are together; body-site and spatial relation are required.
source_excerpt: A gap between the upper thighs just under the crotch that on certain body types is visible when the knees or thighs are together.

semantic_scope: Pose with hands and knees toward the floor like a four-legged animal; body remains off the ground. This is a pose, not merely crawling or kneeling.
source_excerpt: Hands and knees on the floor like a standing four-legged animal. At least one hand and one leg should be on the floor, with the body itself off the ground. If both knees are off the ground, it's bear position.

semantic_scope: A shirt or similar top is lifted up. Includes active self/other lifting and passive lifted/rolled-up states; the canonical is broader than an active-only action phrase.
display_candidate: シャツが持ち上がった状態
source_excerpt: When a person's shirt or similar top is lifted up, often to show their bra, breasts, or bare pectorals. This includes a person actively lifting their own clothes or lifting another's clothes, as well as shirts that are passively lifted or rolled up.

semantic_scope: Character body/head orientation faces the viewer regardless of eye direction; explicitly distinct from looking_at_viewer.
source_excerpt: A character facing the viewer but with their eyes closed, covered, is faceless or looking in another direction. Don't confuse with looking at viewer, which should be used when eyes are open and staring at the viewer.

semantic_scope: A girl with real rabbit-like features such as rabbit ears or a rabbit tail; explicitly not the Playboy-bunny costume concept.
display_candidate: ウサギの特徴を持つ少女
source_excerpt: A girl with real rabbit-like features, such as rabbit ears or a rabbit tail. Not to be confused with Playboy bunny, which are also known as "bunny girls".

semantic_scope: An ellipsis shown in a speech or thought bubble to represent a character being at a loss for words; not generic punctuation outside a bubble.
source_excerpt: An ellipsis (...) that is spoken aloud in a speech bubble or thought bubble. Meant to show that a character is at a loss for words.

semantic_scope: A character visibly walking; in a still image commonly indicated by one foot placed in front of the other.
source_excerpt: When a character is visibly walking. In non-animated pictures, this is usually indicated by one foot being placed in front of the other.

semantic_scope: A tail with a barbed or spade-shaped tip associated with demons/demon girls; distinguish from heart_tail.
source_excerpt: A tail with a barbed or spade-shaped tip often seen on demons or demon girls. Not to be confused with heart tail (when the tail itself is in a heart-shape).
